subject.title: Workspaces: add Living Answers and action forms

question: Should bundled Workspaces ship Living Answers and action forms as a first-party operator interaction surface now?
rationale: This is a substantial new product capability rather than a repair, and the contributor-authored roadmap does not demonstrate permanent maintainer sponsorship for the builtin widget and dispatch contract.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Approve the plugin-owned direction, require visible dispatch-error handling and current-head proof, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow to Living Answers
options.body: Keep ephemeral widgets and pinning while deferring the action-form dispatch surface to a separately approved design.

options.title: Pause both capabilities
options.body: Defer the feature until the broader Workspaces roadmap receives explicit ownership and prioritization.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the plugin-owned direction, require visible dispatch-error handling and current-head proof, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest repository-side review-routing signal available for confirming whether this first-party Workspaces surface is wanted.
